certificate: Projection pi partitions LABELED_FIBER into blocks indexed by raw histories.
Every block has exactly D(T)=product T(x,y)! elements.
The last-exit/local-order bijection counts LABELED_FIBER as L=TAU_r*d_r!*product_{x!=r}(d_x-1)! on positive realizable T.
Thus L=MU*D(T), so D(T) divides the factorial-arborescence numerator and the quotient is exactly MU.
No probability normalization or separate asymptotic divisibility argument is used.
statement: For every realizable finite T and endpoints (s,t), the Stage-D raw formula returns a nonnegative integer equal to MU(T;s,t).
zero_case: For N_T=0 and s=t, MU=1 directly.
